name: Hozumi Shinnousuke
source:
The head of the Marketing Department at Glaðsheimr Japan. He has a lot of business interactions with Kuze, but has no personal relationship with him. A mysterious person with both a friendly and languid atmosphere. He is liked by both men and women and is good at his job, but Kuze finds him hard to read and doesn't want to get involved with him.

[Translated from the [url=http://pro-page.jp/fpp/uuudiary-disk/character.html]Official Website[/url]]
